find_idempotents.signature:
pub fn find_idempotents(
    endomorphisms: &[(&str, &str, bool)],
    compositions: &BTreeMap<(String, String), String>,
) -> Vec<(String, String)>
find_idempotents.obligation: Build one borrowed view and return owned ordered pairs from find_idempotents_in. No category/endomorphism admission; supplied object labels and identity flags remain premises,duplicate candidates preserved.

find_idempotents_in.obligation: Scan every supplied row in original order. Skip identity-flagged rows without looking up idempotence,then retain iff defined composition(mor,mor)=mor. Preserve raw object label and duplicates as required owned output. Missing composition is not idempotence;no string normalization or identity-name inference.

first_retraction.obligation: Private standard finite iterator over supplied from-pairs. Require a defined identity name for this declared retract first,then scan from rows in original order,require matching target/retract string and BOTH defined rs=id_R and sr=idempotent. Return first matching borrowed retraction or None. Missing/mismatched data never equals by two absent Options;caller row boundaries beyond supplied retract equality are unverified.

first_splitting.obligation: Private standard finite to-iterator and cloneable finite from-iterator. For each section/retract row in original order,restart a cheap cloned iterator state (not cloned data),find first_retraction,and return borrowed(section,retract,retraction) tuple. No String/record allocation even on success;no e;e or true category boundary check. First tuple is exactly first successful Cartesian row.

    compositions: &BTreeMap<(String, String), String>,

check_idempotent_splits.obligation: Borrowed view once,then first_splitting on provided slices;only successful returned tuple is converted to required owned IdempotentSplitting fields with exact caller carrier/idempotent. This checks two equations and declared shared retract only,not actual category membership,boundaries,idempotence or complete candidate inventory.

check_cauchy_completeness.signature:
pub fn check_cauchy_completeness(
    endomorphisms: &[(&str, &str, bool)],
    compositions: &BTreeMap<(String, String), String>,
    morphisms_to: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<(String, String)>>,
    morphisms_from: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<(String, String)>>,
    identity_map: &BTreeMap<String, String>,
) -> CauchyStatus
check_cauchy_completeness.obligation: Build one view for all candidates. Borrow original rows directly,skip identity flags or absent/wrong e;e;borrow boundary rows through zero-allocation optional slice iterators. Inspect first_splitting existence without constructing owned witness/candidate records. Append only actual unsplit name outputs,in original order with duplicates. Missing to/from maps are empty. Complete means empty UNSPLIT SUPPLIED INVENTORY only,not mathematical Cauchy completeness of an admitted category.

idempotence_diagnostic.signature: fn idempotence_diagnostic(splitting: &IdempotentSplitting, compositions: &BTreeMap<(String, String), String>) -> Option<String>
idempotence_diagnostic.obligation: One fixed raw tuple-key query for e;e;None reports exact undefined diagnostic,Some wrong value reports exact Not idempotent text,Some e emits none. No loop,category typing or boundary check;carrier is not inspected.

retraction_diagnostic.obligation: One fixed raw query(section,retraction) and identity_map[retract]. Only two defined equal values pass. Two defined unequal values produce exact value/identity message;any missing side produces exact undefined law message. No table ownership or actual identity typing.

section_diagnostic.signature: fn section_diagnostic(splitting: &IdempotentSplitting, compositions: &BTreeMap<(String, String), String>) -> Option<String>
section_diagnostic.obligation: One fixed raw query(retraction,section),require Some(idempotent). Return exact wrong-value or absent diagnostic,otherwise none. Both query orientation and textual payload/order matter.

validate_splitting.signature:
pub fn validate_splitting(
    splitting: &IdempotentSplitting,
    compositions: &BTreeMap<(String, String), String>,
    identity_map: &BTreeMap<String, String>,
) -> Vec<String>
validate_splitting.obligation: Evaluate all three individual diagnostics in original idempotence,retraction,section order and collect every failure (no first-error shortcut). Three fixed queries use existing raw map key API;no full O(C) index for these three checks. It checks literal defined equations only;carrier/category and full map contexts are not admitted.
